summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (placed after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified; hand-checking the batch-of-two case gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333. The TP and D helpers use the spec's cross-sample broadcast form. One pre-existing line in dice.py (line 36) exceeds 120 columns and was left alone. No commits were made.
